# The host object model

How igni appears to a page: the objects, their properties and their signals. The generated half comes from igni's own host schema, and `SCHEMA_VERSION` says which version of it. A field the schema does not describe is listed without a description: the SDK has none to give, and would rather say nothing than write what it does not know.

Read from the source: every name below, its signature, its JSDoc, and — for a type or a class — its own members.

## JsonValue

type JsonValue = unknown

## HostErrorCode

```typescript
type HostErrorCode = "not_granted" | "not_found" | "invalid" | "read_only" | "stage_2" | "refused" | "unavailable" | "failed"
```

Why the host refused or failed — the same codes the Python SDK raises.

## HostError

```typescript
class HostError extends Error
```

The host said no, or it went wrong there. `code` is for code; the message, for people.

| Member | Kind | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `constructor` | method | `(readonly code: HostErrorCode | string, message: string,)` | The failure, as the host reported it. |

### HostError.constructor()

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | `HostErrorCode \| string` | required | why it failed: one of the {@link HostErrorCode}s, or whatever the host said. |
| `message` | `string` | required | a sentence for a person to read. |

## HostLink

```typescript
interface HostLink
```

How requests reach the igni host.

| Member | Kind | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `request` | method | `(op: "get" | "set" | "call", path: string, options: { window?: string | null; session?: string | null; params?: Record<string, unknown>; value?: unknown; },) => Promise<unknown>` | Send one request to the host. |

### HostLink.request()

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `op` | `"get" \| "set" \| "call"` | required | what to do: read a property, write one, or call a method. |
| `path` | `string` | required | where in the model, as `host.chat.processing`. |
| `options` | `{ window?: string \| null; session?: string \| null; params?: Record<string, unknown>; value?: unknown; }` | required | the window or session it is about, the arguments of a call, and the value of a write. |

## HostObject

```typescript
class HostObject
```

One object of the host model: `host.chat`, `host.windows.ui(id)`, `host.sessions.chat(id)`.

| Member | Kind | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `constructor` | method | `(protected readonly link: HostLink, readonly path: string, protected readonly window: string | null = null, protected readonly session: string | null = null,)` | One object of the model, bound to a host. |
| `call` | method | `(name: string, params: Record<string, unknown>,) => Promise<T>` | Call a method on the host. |

### HostObject.constructor()

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `link` | `HostLink` | required | how requests reach the host. |
| `path` | `string` | required | where in the model this object sits. |
| `window` | `string \| null` | `null` | the window it belongs to, when it belongs to one. |
| `session` | `string \| null` | `null` | the session it belongs to, when it belongs to one. |

### HostObject.call()

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |

| `name` | `string` | required | the method's name, as the schema spells it. |
| `params` | `Record<string, unknown>` | required | its arguments, by name. |

## Property

```typescript
class Property<T>
```

A value of a host object: `get()` reads it, `set()` writes it.

| Member | Kind | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `constructor` | method | `(private readonly owner: HostObject, readonly name: string, readonly writable: boolean,)` | One value of one host object. |
| `path` | accessor | `string` | Where in the model this value sits: `host.chat.processing`. |
| `get` | method | `() => Promise<T>` | Read it. |
| `set` | method | `(value: T) => Promise<void>` | Write it, as the person's UI would. Refused where theirs would be. |

### Property.constructor()

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `owner` | `HostObject` | required | the object it belongs to. |
| `name` | `string` | required | its name, as the schema spells it. |
| `writable` | `boolean` | required | whether it may be written. |

### Property.set()

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `T` | required | what the host should hold for it from now on. |

## Signal

```typescript
class Signal<T>
```

One signal of one host object; `T` is what it carries. `name` is its
wire name — `chat.run_completed`, or for the four events that predate
the model their topic strings (`session.switched`, …).

| Member | Kind | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `carries` | field | `T` | Only for the type parameter; never set. |
| `constructor` | method | `(readonly name: string,)` | One signal of one host object. |

### Signal.constructor()

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | required | its wire name, as the host sends it. |

## SCHEMA_VERSION

```typescript
const SCHEMA_VERSION = "1.13.0"
```

The version of igni's host schema this file was generated from.

It moves when igni's host model moves. The bridge carries it on the
wire, so a host and a page can say which model they are speaking.

## Activity

```typescript
interface Activity
```

Whether igni is doing anything. A run waiting only on a person — on an approval, its own or a sub-agent's — is `waiting`, not `running`: nothing happens until the decision, so the process may be suspended and the decision wakes it.

| Member | Kind | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | field | `string` | `idle`, `waiting` or `running`. |
| `suspendable` | field | `boolean` | Nothing is running and nothing is busy. |
| `waiting_approvals` | field | `number` |  |
| `sessions` | field | `SessionActivity[]` |  |
| `busy` | field | `BusyLease[]` | What holds igni busy outside a run's turn: calls out, scheduled tasks, processes, extensions that said they are working (`self.busy`). |
| `wake_at` | field | `string | null` | When something is next due while nothing runs (ISO 8601, UTC): when a suspended igni should be woken. |

| `reason` | field | `string` |  |
| `since` | field | `string` | ISO 8601. |
| `expires_at` | field | `string | null` | ISO 8601; `None` until let go. |

## HostAppState

```typescript
class HostAppState extends HostObject
```

Key–value state of the extension's own, kept by the host across restarts. An extension sees only its own keys.

**Also** [`HostObject`](/docs/sdk/extension-bridge/reference-the-host-object-model#hostobject).

| Member | Kind | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `values` | field | `Property<Record<string, string>>` | Every key and value. |
| `changed` | field | `Signal<StateChange>` | A key was set or deleted. |
| `constructor` | method | `(link: HostLink, window: string | null = null, session: string | null = null,)` | The object igni hands a page, bound to a host and to the window or session it was reached through. |
| `get` | method | `(key: string) => Promise<string | null>` | One value, or `None`. |
| `set` | method | `(key: string, value: string) => Promise<void>` | Store one value. |
| `delete` | method | `(key: string) => Promise<void>` | Remove one key. |

### HostAppState.constructor()

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `link` | `HostLink` | required | The link this object talks to the host through. |
| `window` | `string \| null` | `null` | The window it was reached through, or null for the one the page is in. |
| `session` | `string \| null` | `null` | The session it was reached through, or null for the one on screen. |

### HostAppState.get()

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | `string` | required | The key to read the value of. |

### HostAppState.set()

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | `string` | required | The key to store the value under. |
| `value` | `string` | required | The value to store. |

### HostAppState.delete()

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | `string` | required | The key to remove. |

## HostChatApprovals

```typescript
class HostChatApprovals extends HostObject
```

The agent asking to act, and the answers. Through `host.sessions.chat(id)` `waiting` reads that session; an approval is answered only in the session on screen.

**Also** [`HostObject`](/docs/sdk/extension-bridge/reference-the-host-object-model#hostobject).

| Member | Kind | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `waiting` | field | `Property<Approval[]>` | Requests not yet answered. |
| `requested` | field | `Signal<Approval>` | The agent asked. |
| `resolved` | field | `Signal<ApprovalResolved>` | Somebody answered. |
| `details` | field | `Signal<ApprovalDetails>` | The reason arrived. |
| `changed` | field | `Signal<ApprovalChange>` | An approval appeared or went away, whoever answered and whenever — including after a restart. For an app following approvals through the API. |
| `constructor` | method | `(link: HostLink, window: string | null = null, session: string | null = null,)` | The object igni hands a page, bound to a host and to the window or session it was reached through. |
| `answer` | method | `(requirement_id: string, action: string, choice?: string) => Promise<void>` | Answer one request, as the person's dialog does. |
| `answer_all` | method | `(answers: ApprovalAnswer[]) => Promise<void>` | Answer every request of a pause at once. |

### HostChatApprovals.constructor()

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `link` | `HostLink` | required | The link this object talks to the host through. |
| `window` | `string \| null` | `null` | The window it was reached through, or null for the one the page is in. |
| `session` | `string \| null` | `null` | The session it was reached through, or null for the one on screen. |

### HostChatApprovals.answer()

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `requirement_id` | `string` | required | The waiting request to answer, by its id. |
| `action` | `string` | required | `confirm` or `reject`. |
| `choice` | `string` | optional | `once`, `always` or `similar`. |

### HostChatApprovals.answer_all()

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `answers` | `ApprovalAnswer[]` | required | The answers to give, one per waiting request. |

## HostChat

```typescript
class HostChat extends HostObject
```

The conversation in the current session. Signals carry the session they happened in, and arrive for every live session. `host.sessions.chat(id)` is the same object for any session of this project, without showing it: its properties read that session, and `post`, `queue`, `append` and `replace` write there (with `sessions.post` as well). A message posted there starts a run, or waits for the run already going there — never answering an approval. Its other methods act only on the session on screen.

**Also** [`HostObject`](/docs/sdk/extension-bridge/reference-the-host-object-model#hostobject).

| Member | Kind | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `approvals` | field | `HostChatApprovals` | `host.chat.approvals`. The agent asking to act, and the answers. Through `host.sessions.chat(id)` `waiting` reads that session; an approval is answered only in the session on screen. |
| `views` | field | `HostChatViews` | `host.chat.views`. json-render blocks in the transcript — the visualizer's and extensions'. Through `host.sessions.chat(id)` `list` reads that session; `dispatch` acts only in the session on screen. |
| `session_id` | field | `Property<string>` | The current session. |
| `messages` | field | `Property<JsonValue[]>` | The transcript, turn by turn. |
| `pending` | field | `Property<JsonValue[]>` | Messages waiting for a turn. |
| `processing` | field | `Property<boolean>` | Whether a run is going. |
| `status` | field | `Property<Status>` | The status line. |
| `timeout` | field | `Property<number>` | Seconds a run may take. |
| `interrupted_runs` | field | `Property<JsonValue[]>` | Runs that stopped part-way. |
| `context` | field | `Property<ContextUsage>` | Token counts and what fills them. |
| `message_added` | field | `Signal<ChatMessage>` | A message was posted — by the person, an extension, or an extension's service (`from_service`). |
| `content_delta` | field | `Signal<ContentDelta>` | The agent's answer, streaming. |
| `reasoning_started` | field | `Signal<RunRef>` | The agent started thinking. |
| `run_started` | field | `Signal<RunStart>` | A run started. |
| `run_completed` | field | `Signal<Run>` | A run finished, with the files it changed. |
| `run_error` | field | `Signal<RunFailure>` | A run stopped with an error. |
| `run_paused` | field | `Signal<RunPause>` | A run is waiting for approvals. |
| `streaming_done` | field | `Signal<RunRef>` | The answer finished streaming. |
| `typing` | field | `Signal<Typing>` | Somebody's draft, live. |
| `status_changed` | field | `Signal<Status>` | The status line changed. |
| `info` | field | `Signal<Notice>` | An info line. |
| `error` | field | `Signal<Notice>` | An error line. |
| `tool_started` | field | `Signal<ToolCall>` | The agent called a tool. |
| `tool_completed` | field | `Signal<ToolResult>` | A tool call finished. |
| `tool_error` | field | `Signal<ToolFailure>` | A tool call failed. |
| `model_completed` | field | `Signal<ModelUsage>` | A model call finished. |
| `file_edited` | field | `Signal<FileEdited>` | The agent wrote a file. |
| `agent_event` | field | `Signal<AgentEvent>` | A sub-agent or team moved on. |
| `retry` | field | `Signal<Retry>` | A network call is being retried. |
| `history_changed` | field | `Signal<HistoryChange>` | Turns were truncated or discarded. |
| `constructor` | method | `(link: HostLink, window: string | null = null, session: string | null = null,)` | The object igni hands a page, bound to a host and to the window or session it was reached through. |
| `post` | method | `(text: string, attachments?: Record<string, string>) => Promise<void>` | Post a message in the chat, labelled as this extension. The agent sees it and answers in the chat as usual. |
| `queue` | method | `(text: string) => Promise<void>` | Post a message for the next turn, labelled as this extension. |
| `append` | method | `(view: JsonValue, title?: string) => Promise<string>` | Show a json-render block in the transcript. Shown to the person, never sent to the model. Returns its id. |
| `replace` | method | `(view_id: string, view: JsonValue, title?: string) => Promise<void>` | Replace a block this extension appended. |
| `search` | method | `(query: string, limit?: number) => Promise<JsonValue[]>` | Search the transcript. |
| `cancel` | method | `() => Promise<void>` | Stop the run. |
| `cancel_agent` | method | `(run_id: string) => Promise<void>` | Stop one sub-agent's run. |
| `truncate` | method | `(run_id: string) => Promise<JsonValue>` | Remove a run and everything after it. |
| `compact` | method | `() => Promise<SessionCleared | null>` | Compact the conversation if it needs it, as igni does after a run. |
| `extract_learnings` | method | `(user_msg: string, assistant_msg: string) => Promise<void>` | Have the agent note what a turn taught it. |
| `discard_interrupted` | method | `(message_id: string) => Promise<JsonValue>` | Forget an interrupted run. |
| `upload` | method | `(filename: string, content_base64: string) => Promise<JsonValue>` | Upload an attachment for a later `post`. |

## Host

```typescript
class Host extends HostObject
```

The root. `changed` reports every change anywhere in the model, for an extension that wants to see all of it; each delivery needs the grant of the member that changed.

**Also** [`HostObject`](/docs/sdk/extension-bridge/reference-the-host-object-model#hostobject).

| Member | Kind | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `app` | field | `HostApp` | `host.app`. igni itself: how it presents things, which version, whether it is connected. |
| `windows` | field | `HostWindows` | `host.windows`. Every open igni window. Address one window's UI with `host.windows.ui(id)`. |
| `ui` | field | `HostUi` | `host.ui`. What a window shows — the model its views bind to. `host.ui` is the active window, the one the person last used; `host.windows.ui(id)` any window. |
| `sessions` | field | `HostSessions` | `host.sessions`. The sessions of this project, and which one the active window shows. Reach any session's chat, without showing it, with `host.sessions.chat(id)`. |
| `chat` | field | `HostChat` | `host.chat`. The conversation in the current session. Signals carry the session they happened in, and arrive for every live session. |
| `plan` | field | `HostPlan` | `host.plan`. Plan mode: the plan the agent proposed. |
| `tasks` | field | `HostTasks` | `host.tasks`. The agent's todo list and its sub-agent tasks. |
| `loop` | field | `HostLoop` | `host.loop`. `/loop`: a prompt repeated until done. |
| `commands` | field | `HostCommands` | `host.commands`. Slash commands and skills. |
| `agents` | field | `HostAgents` | `host.agents`. Agent definitions. |
| `workflows` | field | `HostWorkflows` | `host.workflows`. Workflows: scripted runs. |
| `scheduler` | field | `HostScheduler` | `host.scheduler`. Scheduled tasks. |
| `processes` | field | `HostProcesses` | `host.processes`. Background shells. |
| `workspace` | field | `HostWorkspace` | `host.workspace`. The project, as far as the extension's workspace grant reaches. |
| `models` | field | `HostModels` | `host.models`. Models. |
| `mcp` | field | `HostMcp` | `host.mcp`. MCP servers. |
| `plugins` | field | `HostPlugins` | `host.plugins`. Plugins and marketplaces. |
| `extensions` | field | `HostExtensions` | `host.extensions`. Installed extensions. Read-only, apart from this extension's own settings. |
| `hooks` | field | `HostHooks` | `host.hooks`. Hooks. |
| `permissions` | field | `HostPermissions` | `host.permissions`. What the agent may do without asking. |
| `policy` | field | `HostPolicy` | `host.policy`. The group policy in force. |
| `account` | field | `HostAccount` | `host.account`. Whether the person is signed in to igni. Never their session or a credential. |
| `notifications` | field | `HostNotifications` | `host.notifications`. The floor's notifications. Its own always; everyone's with `notifications`. |
| `self` | field | `HostSelf` | `host.self`. This extension, as the host sees it. |
| `changed` | field | `Signal<Change>` | Anything changed. Carries the member's path and its new value. |
| `constructor` | method | `(link: HostLink, window: string | null = null, session: string | null = null,)` | The object igni hands a page, bound to a host and to the window or session it was reached through. |
| `decide` | method | `(context: Record<string, string>, questions: DecisionQuestion[]) => Promise<Decision>` | Ask igni's local decision model (Laya) typed questions about a context, in one pass on this machine. |
| `decide_batch` | method | `(contexts: (Record<string, string>)[], questions: DecisionQuestion[]) => Promise<Decision[]>` | `decide` for up to 16 contexts at once, sharing forward passes. One decision per context, in order. |

### Host.constructor()

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `link` | `HostLink` | required | The link this object talks to the host through. |

| `session` | `string \| null` | `null` | The session it was reached through, or null for the one on screen. |
